name: liquid-field
title: Liquid Field
description: Slow flowing colour like ink in water or silk in wind, drawn by a tiny WebGL fragment shader with a CSS gradient fallback.

meta.reducedMotion: A still frame of the same colours.
meta.useWhen: The material really is liquid, fabric, light or weather; behind a hero with one line of type.
meta.avoidWhen: As generic "AI gradient" decoration; behind body text; on pages that already use WebGL.
